notes: Refined stories to tighten validation contracts, safety-aligned history injection, and test coverage specificity. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Clarified strict schema alignment with Anthropic tool_use payload and standardized 422 error contract across all tool_models.
Added de-identification and safety filtering alignment with shared safety/consent services during chat history injection.
change_log.note: Address safety risk without scope expansion

change_log.value: Specified structured error propagation and normalization of tool results back into agent loop.
Expanded to include Anthropic tool_use loop edge cases and validation failure scenarios.

stories.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools including strict input models, optional/required fields, defaulting rules, and standardized validation error responses (422 contract). Ensure schemas align exactly with Anthropic tool_use payload structure and existing tool_models modules.

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement core routing logic that dispatches tool calls using an explicit allowlist. Reject unknown tools, bind each tool to its Pydantic schema, validate inputs, and normalize invocation payloads prior to execution.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Implement controlled chat history injection into tool execution context, including truncation/token limits, role filtering, and de-identification aligned with shared safety and consent patterns. Ensure compatibility with downstream domain services.

stories.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
stories.description: Integrate tool routing and validation into the FastAPI main loop: parse Anthropic tool_use blocks, invoke router dispatch, handle validation errors with structured responses, and normalize tool outputs back into the agent loop.

stories.title: Tool Routing and Validation Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation (success and failure), tool dispatch correctness, chat history injection behavior, and Anthropic tool_use loop edge cases.
